title: Random Cube Generator
description: Practice 3D rotation and perspective construction with a randomized geometric volume.

title: Two Boxes
description: Draw two boxes of different sizes, turned to different angles, on one ground plane, and change the height of the eye to see how the view shifts.

title: Rotation Grid
description: Study standard drafting angles (15°, 30°, 45°) and observe how position within the cone of vision alters foreshortening.

title: Shadow from a Local Light
description: Find where a stick's shadow falls on a plane when the light is close by, and watch it change as the light moves up and down.

title: Shadows on Several Levels
description: Find the shadows of sticks standing on blocks of different heights, with the shadow origin raised to the level of each block.

title: Sunlight Construction
description: Find the shadows of sticks in sunlight, with the sun in front of you (positive) or behind you (negative), using the sun, the horizon and the sun's shadow origin.

title: Blind Contour
description: Draw the edges of a museum object without looking at your paper, against a timer.

title: Verify Cubes
description: Photograph a cube you drew and see the lines the tool finds in it.

title: Upside Down
description: Copy a line drawing shown upside down, so you draw the lines you see instead of what you think the subject is.
